title: info/v2
description: info.json (F03-R10; D-28 server_info): protocol version, the schema index (name to versions), per-target gate-spec hash and pinned network commit (D-35), the rate-limit policy (null until F05) and the graph commit the products were rendered from. v2 (2026-10-04, F05-T25): `guide_url` and `errors_url` name the contributor guide and the error-code catalog (GET /errors.json). Where they live is a fact about a deployment, not about the graph, so the committed file carries null for both and the service fills them from its own configuration on every read, as it fills `rate_limit_policy`.

protocol_version.description: the architecture decisions version the products follow

guide_url.description: the contributor guide; null in the committed file, filled by the service from its configuration

errors_url.description: the error-code catalog (GET /errors.json); null in the committed file, filled by the service from its configuration
